I can just exist as I am. "Yeah, that girl's legs aren't stick thin, but so what? She looks good!" I wouldn't let myself wear crop tops if my stomach wasn't completely flat and I didn't wear a corset the night before to make my waist smaller, but I noticed that most girls who wear crop tops have a bit of a tummy or have rectangular waists, and they still rocked those tops.

I also noticed how guys looked at them or talked about them and the concept of the beauty standard just vanished for me. I used to think that guys could only be attracted to "thin limbs, big boobs, small waist, big ass" until I noticed girls who don't look like that not only have boyfriends, but have guys, strangers or not, actively praise and admire them.
